scripts.title: omni::fleet-runtimes-upgrade
scripts.description: Atualizacao de Node 24 LTS via NVM, npm, pnpm, Bun, uv, Python 3.13, pip e GitHub CLI na frota.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-health-check
scripts.description: Comprehensive fleet health check, D-state audit, stale IP check, and reconcile.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-status
scripts.description: Read-only host status snapshot for Landscape fleet operations.

scripts.title: omni::version-report
scripts.description: Read-only package/tool version report for Omni governance.

scripts.title: omni::pm2-root-cleanup
scripts.description: Stops only accidental root-owned PM2 daemon with PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 and moves /root/.pm2 aside.

scripts.title: omni::apt-upgrade-plan
scripts.description: APT simulation only: shows upgrade/autoremove plan without mutating packages.

scripts.title: omni::reboot-required
scripts.description: Reports reboot-required state and related package hints.

scripts.title: omni::antigravity-tarball-cleanup
scripts.description: Purges legacy Antigravity manual tarball extractions, build artifacts and downloads across the fleet.

scripts.title: omni::sync-agent-instructions
scripts.description: Synchronizes canonical AI instructions, skills, agents, and modular rules across all fleet nodes via multilateral Any-to-All Git state machine with 15-minute systemd timer.

scripts.title: omni::skills-inventory
scripts.description: Read-only inventory of AI skills count, atius-vault-access propagation, ~/.agents/skills symlink health, and Landscape directive presence across the fleet.

scripts.title: omni::agy-sessions-list
scripts.description: Lista sessoes Antigravity CLI/IDE recentes de cada host via SQLite e JSONL. Retorna titulo, ID, turnos, workspace e timestamp das ultimas 15 sessoes principais.

scripts.title: omni::xrdp-audit
scripts.description: Auditoria de status do XRDP, sesman, portas X11/VNC e sessões ativas na frota.

scripts.title: omni::antigravity-hub-install
scripts.description: Instala ou atualiza o Antigravity Hub (2.0) a partir do tarball oficial na frota, gerando symlink /usr/local/bin/antigravity e atalho .desktop 'Antigravity 2.0' na categoria Development.

scripts.title: omni::xrdp-enforce-single-session-override
scripts.description: Aplica politica de sessao unica no XRDP em toda a frota: encerra sessoes em disconnect (KillDisconnected=true), elimina orfaos Xvnc, previne colisao de portas (5901->5900) e garante sobreposicao de novas conexoes.

scripts.title: omni::antigravity-ui-dimension-fix
scripts.description: Aplica correcao de dimensionamento e corte no topo da janela do Antigravity na frota (titleBarStyle=native no settings.json e decor=yes no Openbox lxde-rc.xml).

scripts.title: omni::fleet-repo-sync
scripts.description: Synchronizes git repositories across ATIUS fleet with declarative policy enforcement.

scripts.title: omni::terminal-multiplexer-fleet-tune
scripts.description: Configura Tmux (OSC 52 clipboard, mouse scroll, sem travamento de tela) e aliases/funcao do Zellij (-c attach-or-create, -s session) na frota.

scripts.title: omni::setup-fleet-gdrive
scripts.description: Instala, configura e reconcilia o mount governado do Google Drive (/mnt/gdrive) via rclone, Vault e gdrive-mount.service na frota ATIUS.

scripts.title: omni::gdrive-fleet-setup
scripts.description: Alias para setup-fleet-gdrive. Instala, configura e reconcilia o mount do Google Drive (/mnt/gdrive) via rclone e HashiCorp Vault em toda a frota com quotas de cache VFS estritas por host.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-backup-databases
scripts.description: Executa backup completo, seguro e com checksum de todos os bancos de dados da frota (PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Vault Raft, Vaultwarden, Mailu) para /mnt/gdrive.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-autoclean-and-log-purge
scripts.description: Limpeza automatica de espaco em disco, journald vacuum, purge de logs SSSD/PostgreSQL/XRDP, caches de build e containers podman/docker.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-auto-upgrades-configure
scripts.description: Configura atualizacoes automaticas de seguranca desassistidas (unattended-upgrades) com cota rigorosa de CPU <=20% (Nice=19, CPUQuota=20%, idle IO) e sem reboot automatico em toda a frota ATIUS.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-podman-passt-install
scripts.description: Instala passt (/usr/bin/pasta) para networking rootless do Podman Engine sob cota <=20% CPU e audita Linger e servicos.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-apt-proxy-configure
scripts.description: Configura proxy APT centralizado via rota privada OCI DRG (10.13.1.13:3142) e persistencia em GDrive, eliminando downloads duplicados e divergencia de hashes na frota.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-paseo-install
scripts.description: Instalacao padronizada do runtime Paseo CLI, Server e ACP na frota via NVM Node 24, portas dedicadas e daemons systemd.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-paseo-apache-edge
scripts.description: Configura Atius Admin Edge SSO (:8210) e Apache Edge Gateway no atius-srv-1 para o Paseo Hub (10.14.1.14:37845) no Padrão PM2 Canônico.

scripts.title: omni::fleet-paseo-status
scripts.description: Verifica status da CLI, servico systemd, porta dedicada e daemon local do Paseo na frota.
